theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (a a_1 a_2 a_3 : MilleniumCore.Expr α), (a.sub a_1 = a_2.sub a_3) = (a = a_2 ∧ a_1 = a_3)

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.Expr.sub.sizeOf_spec
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : SizeOf α] (a a_1 : MilleniumCore.Expr α), sizeOf (a.sub a_1) = 1 + sizeOf a + sizeOf a_1

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.Expr.var.inj
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} {a a_1 : String}, MilleniumCore.Expr.var a = MilleniumCore.Expr.var a_1 → a = a_1

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.Expr.var.injEq
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (a a_1 : String), (MilleniumCore.Expr.var a = MilleniumCore.Expr.var a_1) = (a = a_1)

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.Expr.var.sizeOf_spec
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : SizeOf α] (a : String), sizeOf (MilleniumCore.Expr.var a) = 1 + sizeOf a

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.IndetClass.mk.inj
theorems.statement: ∀ {k k_1 : Nat}, MilleniumCore.IndetClass.mk k = MilleniumCore.IndetClass.mk k_1 → k = k_1

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.IndetClass.mk.injEq
theorems.statement: ∀ (k k_1 : Nat), (MilleniumCore.IndetClass.mk k = MilleniumCore.IndetClass.mk k_1) = (k = k_1)

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.IndetClass.mk.sizeOf_spec
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : Nat), sizeOf (MilleniumCore.IndetClass.mk k) = 1 + sizeOf k

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.State.mk.inj
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} {equalities equalities_1 : List (MilleniumCore.Expr α × MilleniumCore.Expr α)},   { equalities := equalities } = { equalities := equalities_1 } → equalities = equalities_1

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.State.mk.injEq
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} (equalities equalities_1 : List (MilleniumCore.Expr α × MilleniumCore.Expr α)),   ({ equalities := equalities } = { equalities := equalities_1 }) = (equalities = equalities_1)

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.State.mk.sizeOf_spec
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : SizeOf α] (equalities : List (MilleniumCore.Expr α × MilleniumCore.Expr α)),   sizeOf { equalities := equalities } = 1 + sizeOf equalities

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.applyOp.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] (op : α → α → α) (isDivision : Bool) (a b : α),   MilleniumCore.applyOp op isDivision (MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar a) (MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar b) =     if (isDivision && b == 0) = true then MilleniumCore.EvalResult.indet MilleniumCore.IndetClass.zero     else MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar (op a b)

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.applyOp.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] (op : α → α → α) (isDivision : Bool)   (r : MilleniumCore.EvalResult α) (k : MilleniumCore.IndetClass),   MilleniumCore.applyOp op isDivision (MilleniumCore.EvalResult.indet k) r = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.indet k

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.applyOp.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α] (op : α → α → α) (isDivision : Bool)   (l : MilleniumCore.EvalResult α) (k : MilleniumCore.IndetClass),   (∀ (k : MilleniumCore.IndetClass), l = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.indet k → False) →     MilleniumCore.applyOp op isDivision l (MilleniumCore.EvalResult.indet k) = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.indet k

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval.eq_1
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α) (a : String),   MilleniumCore.eval v η (MilleniumCore.Expr.var a) = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar (v a)

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval.eq_2
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α) (a : α),   MilleniumCore.eval v η (MilleniumCore.Expr.const a) = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar a

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval.eq_3
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α)   (a : MilleniumCore.IndetClass),   MilleniumCore.eval v η (MilleniumCore.Expr.indet a) =     match η a with     | some c => MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar c     | none => MilleniumCore.EvalResult.indet

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval.eq_4
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α)   (a a_1 : MilleniumCore.Expr α),   MilleniumCore.eval v η (a.add a_1) =     MilleniumCore.applyOp (fun x1 x2 => x1 + x2) false (MilleniumCore.eval v η a) (MilleniumCore.eval v η a_1)

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval.eq_5
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α)   (a a_1 : MilleniumCore.Expr α),   MilleniumCore.eval v η (a.sub a_1) =     MilleniumCore.applyOp (fun x1 x2 => x1 - x2) false (MilleniumCore.eval v η a) (MilleniumCore.eval v η a_1)

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval.eq_6
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α)   (a a_1 : MilleniumCore.Expr α),   MilleniumCore.eval v η (a.mul a_1) =     MilleniumCore.applyOp (fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2) false (MilleniumCore.eval v η a) (MilleniumCore.eval v η a_1)

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval.eq_7
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α)   (a a_1 : MilleniumCore.Expr α),   MilleniumCore.eval v η (a.div a_1) =     MilleniumCore.applyOp (fun x1 x2 => x1 / x2) true (MilleniumCore.eval v η a) (MilleniumCore.eval v η a_1)

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval_add_const
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α) (a b : α),   MilleniumCore.eval v η ((MilleniumCore.Expr.const a).add (MilleniumCore.Expr.const b)) =     MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar (a + b)

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval_add_indet_left
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α)   (e₁ e₂ : MilleniumCore.Expr α) (k : MilleniumCore.IndetClass),   MilleniumCore.eval v η e₁ = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.indet k →     MilleniumCore.eval v η (e₁.add e₂) = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.indet k

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval_add_scalars
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α)   (e₁ e₂ : MilleniumCore.Expr α) (a b : α),   MilleniumCore.eval v η e₁ = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar a →     MilleniumCore.eval v η e₂ = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar b →       MilleniumCore.eval v

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval_const
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α) (c : α),   MilleniumCore.eval v η (MilleniumCore.Expr.const c) = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar c

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval_div_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α)   (e₁ e₂ : MilleniumCore.Expr α) (a : α),   MilleniumCore.eval v η e₁ = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar a →     MilleniumCore.eval v η e₂ = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar 0 →       MilleniumCore.eval v η

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval_indet_resolved
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α)   (k : MilleniumCore.IndetClass) (c : α),   η k = some c → MilleniumCore.eval v η (MilleniumCore.Expr.indet k) = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar c

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval_indet_unresolved
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α)   (k : MilleniumCore.IndetClass),   η k = none → MilleniumCore.eval v η (MilleniumCore.Expr.indet k) = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.indet k

theorems.name: MilleniumCore.eval_var
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [inst : Add α] [inst_1 : Sub α] [inst_2 : Mul α] [inst_3 : Div α] [inst_4 : Zero α]   [inst_5 : DecidableEq α] (v : MilleniumCore.VarValuation α) (η : MilleniumCore.IndetValuation α) (s : String),   MilleniumCore.eval v η (MilleniumCore.Expr.var s) = MilleniumCore.EvalResult.scalar (v s)
